title: Marines Conduct Recovery Operation to Retrieve Crashed AV-8B Harrier II from Residential Area in Imperial, California
description: Marines from Marine Corps Air Station Yuma continued in the recovery of an AV-8B Harrier II aircraft that crashed into a residential area of Imperial, Calif., June fourth.  The Operation included the extensive use of a crane and supporting Marines to locate and remove parts of the destroyed aircraft from the impact crater.
